name: Hold Steady
prompt: Generate a single standalone illustration for an engraved nautical fantasy card game. Match reference's 19th century copperplate crosshatching, stippling, faded sepia-gold objects and deep navy watercolor foam, richly detailed antique naturalist field journal feel. Wide horizontal vignette, roughly 16:9, completely transparent outside irregular feathered ink silhouette. No parchment rectangle, no frame, no title, no lettering, no UI, no card face. Readable large centerpiece; detailed linework. Reference is style only, do not reproduce its knot. A weathered brass anchor planted firmly into a craggy reef, its short taut rope resisting a crashing deep navy wave. Protective steadiness against danger, compact horizontal composition.
